[EFFECT] Being a public holiday (coded as 1) is associated with lower predicted demand compared to a regular day (coded as 0), producing a step-down effect on the forecast. The narrow spread indicates this is the weakest influence in the model overall.
[IMPORTANCE] This is the least important feature (rank 9), with a narrow spread — its effect on predictions is negligible relative to the other features.
[RECOMMENDATION] Focus operational planning — bike availability, rebalancing, and staffing — primarily around the hour of the day and the temperature, as these two features drive the largest swings in predicted demand by a considerable margin. Scheduling more resources during high-demand hours and warmer conditions will have the greatest impact on meeting customer needs.
